privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Short version: there is no analytics on this site, no ads, and no tracking. The only data it ever holds is what you type into the contact form yourself, plus a few settings your browser remembers.
privacy.dontDo.heading: What this site does not do
privacy.dontDo.body: No Google Analytics, no tracking pixels, no advertising scripts, no fingerprinting. Nothing about you is sold or shared, and no profile is built from your visits.
privacy.host.heading: Hosting and DNS
privacy.host.body: The site is a set of static files. Requests pass through Cloudflare, which sees your IP address and basic browser details in order to serve the pages, the same as any web host or CDN. No analytics from Cloudflare is enabled here.
privacy.bot.heading: Spam protection
privacy.bot.body: The contact form is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile. It loads only when you open the form, and most people never see a challenge. Your browser is checked, your IP address is sent to Cloudflare to confirm the check, and nothing from Turnstile is stored on my side — I only receive a yes or a no.
privacy.form.heading: Sending me a message
privacy.form.body: The form asks for your name, your email address, and your message. The message goes to a Cloudflare Worker, which checks it, rate limits by address, and forwards it to my inbox by email. It is not saved in any database on this site, and I use your email address for one thing only: to reply to you.
privacy.storage.heading: What your browser remembers
privacy.storage.body: A few small values stay in your browser so the site remembers your choices. They never leave your device, and clearing site data removes all of them:
privacy.storage.theme: theme — keeps your light or dark choice
privacy.storage.lang: lang — keeps the language you picked
privacy.storage.layout: layout — keeps your column width choice
privacy.links.heading: Links to other sites
privacy.links.body: Links here point to places like GitHub and LinkedIn. Once you click through, their privacy policies apply, not this one.
privacy.rights.heading: Your data, your call
privacy.rights.body: Nothing is stored that I can't delete on request. If you want something removed, or you want to know what was sent, just ask — that includes asking me to delete a message you sent.
privacy.changes.heading: Changes to this page
privacy.changes.body: If anything here changes, this page and the date at the top change with it.
